policy: syntactic only: normalized duplicates (invariant_dedup_key + commutative ||/&&), tautologies (e op e, constant-true, A ==> taut, A ==> A), unconditional clauses whose atoms are all covered by other unconditional atomic clauses (atoms kept, conjunctions/chains dropped), implications whose consequent is covered, disjunctions with a covered disjunct; no truncation to 20, no rewriting
